name: formly-contract
description: Compile Angular Formly configurations into deterministic, agent-readable contracts.

scripts.build: pnpm build:demo && pnpm --filter @formly-contract/formly-test-app build && pnpm build:fixtures
scripts.build:demo: pnpm --filter @formly-contract/schema build && pnpm --filter @formly-contract/compiler build && pnpm --filter @formly-contract/workspace build && pnpm --filter @formly-contract/synthetic-form build && pnpm --filter @formly-contract/demo-cli build
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm release:check && pnpm pack:check && pnpm check:demo && pnpm check:docs
